verdict.rationale: The docs describe Bugbot as analyzing PR diffs, and the only repository-level context shown is manual: project guidelines in `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files and prior PR comments. Configurable effort levels allow deeper reasoning, but nothing in the evidence shows it automatically examining call sites or related modules outside the changed hunks. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic whole-repo indexing or cross-file analysis, call-site and related-module awareness, automatic inference of existing conventions (not only hand-written BUGBOT.md rules), and independent or hands-on corroboration of repo-wide context in review comments.
